name: self.browser.open
description: Opens a URL in the run's browser and observes the page whole, in pages read on with observe and next; site_skills hold the exact-origin skills of the page it landed on, notes why none loaded; a blocked page is the cue to switch_engine.

host.description: Opens a URL in the attached run's own browser session and observes the page whole, in pages read on with observe and next; site_skills hold the exact-origin skills of the page it landed on, and site_skill_notes say why none loaded.
